verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only fragments of a model card. Platform docs list flagship capabilities: context window, image input, tools, and a per-model compare table. Community items reference published evals, such as an OpenAI employee on publishing evals and GPT-5.5's 82.7% Terminal Bench score. Nothing shows an actual published model card or system card. Missing for 10: an evidenced system/model card document for the current flagship, training-approach disclosure, intended-use and limitations sections, and first-party evaluation results.
